purpose: The heading of one band inside a page: an h2 with a one-line description, a copy-link button that appears when the heading is hovered or focused (when it has an `anchor`), and the band's own actions on the right. Below `md` the actions drop under the copy.
useWhen: A band of a page that holds a card, a table or a list: Payment information on Billing, Get started on a resource, General in a create form.
A band that someone should be able to link to (`anchor`).
avoidWhen: A settings band whose guidance sits in a Hint and whose body is a card of setting rows → use `settings-section`.
related: settings-section` — the settings band with a Hint, a gutter copy-link and an optional disclosure.
copy-button` — the copy-link affordance it renders.
bestPractices: Keep the description to one sentence; put longer guidance in the band body.
Set `anchor` on bands people link to, so the h2 takes the id and the copy-link button appears.
Keep band actions to one or two outlined medium buttons.
